question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

I mean that is a __remarkable__ finding.
solution:
The correct answer is "**noticeable**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "remarkable" means extraordinary or exceptional.**(विलक्षण)

 
 
• Example: "I have to say I find that fact as remarkable as it is humbling.
 
 
 
• The synonym of "remarkable" is **"noticeable," which means something that can be seen easily or remarkable.**(ध्यान देने योग्य)
 
 
• Example: The temple is noticeable for the fresco above the door.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "noticeable" is the synonym of the word "remarkable."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (subtle) means not obvious or difficult to perceive.(जटिल)
 
• Option 2 (standard) means normal or usual.(मानक)
 
• Option 4 (dim) means not bright or clear.(धुंधला)
